maddeler.e:
نتلامس (form VI)
# نَتَلَامَسُ (natalāmasu) /na.ta.laː.ma.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَلَامَسَ (talāmasa)
# نَتَلَامَسَ (natalāmasa) /na.ta.laː.ma.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَلَامَسَ (talāmasa)
# نَتَلَامَسْ (natalāmas) /na.ta.laː.mas/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَلَامَسَ (talāmasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
